Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Financial analysts annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Financial and Investment Analysts ($124,790). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $124,790, Chicago $101,750, Austin $101,530. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Financial analysts?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Financial and Investment Analysts (17,150 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 17,150, Seattle 6,170, Austin 3,530. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Financial analysts most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Chicago has the highest published location quotient (1.63). Published LQs: Chicago 1.63, Seattle 1.27, Austin 1.17.

What is the hourly median for Financial analysts in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $48.81; Chicago $48.92; Seattle $60.00. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
